game.q: he had crowds. why ask just three friends to stay awake?
opts: he needed guards for the garden
on his hardest night, he didn’t want to be alone
to see who could last longest
game.right: YES. even he wanted someone near. asking for company isn’t weakness.

end.line: on his hardest night, jesus asked his friends to stay near. you can ask too.
end.l2: he asked his friends to stay near.
